frontage.reason: The north arrow at the lower left points toward the left edge of the image, labeled N, so the top of the image is east. Lot 71's front line, marked 60, lies on the top of the parcel along the Glasgow Ave right-of-way. Glasgow Ave is labeled across the top of the map. The lot therefore fronts east onto Glasgow Ave.

uncertainties: Identity is confirmed from visible map labels: the header reads 4103 | 11, the bottom reads TRACT NO. 11569, tract lot 71 is printed in the parcel, and circled assessor number 2 is inside lot 71. This matches AIN 4103-011-002.

The lot is not rectangular. Its side lines carry different printed lengths: 120.88 on the line shared with lot 72 and 115.91 on the line shared with lot 70. The front is marked 60 and the rear is marked 60.2. The rear line, shared with lots 84, 85 and 86, is skewed relative to the front. The 60 front and 60.2 rear are not equal opposite widths, and no bearings are printed. So no scalar lot_width_ft or lot_depth_ft is reported.
No lot area is printed for lot 71, so lot_area_sqft is omitted. An area derived from a rectangle would be invalid because the parcel is irregular.
No ditto marks apply to lot 71. All four edge dimensions are printed explicitly.
The figure 60 printed beside Glasgow Ave is the street right-of-way width, not a lot dimension.
Measurements were not estimated from the map scale (1 inch = 60 ft).
